description: The GeoAI Challenge for Landslide Susceptibility Mapping (June to October 2023) on Zindi asked for a susceptibility map of a watershed in Valtellina, northern Italy. Contents: a digital terrain model at 5 m per pixel from Lombardy Region; a training layer combining a 1:10,000 inventory of translational and rotational shallow landslides and debris flows (target 1, modified from the ISPRA and Lombardy Region IFFI Italian landslide inventory) with a no-landslide zone layer derived from slope and lithology by GISGeolab at Politecnico di Milano; variable definitions and satellite images; participants could add open data such as Landsat or Sentinel-1 and 2 if disclosed. Producer: Zindi challenge with Politecnico di Milano partners. Coverage: one Valtellina watershed, Lombardy. Format and access: Train and Test tables, a datasets archive of rasters and variable definitions from Zindi after joining. Licence: the pages read do not state a data licence; use follows the competition rules. Caveats: the no-landslide layer is itself modelled, and results apply to one watershed. Simulation uses: landslide susceptibility inputs for exposure of Alpine roads, railways and utility lines. Related records: model-nasa-lhasa-2-landslide-hazard-assessment-situational-awareness.
